label: Opening range breakout (15m)
summary: Closes above the 15-minute opening range high on at least 2x relative volume and above VWAP.

label: Pre-market high break
summary: Closes above the pre-market high on at least 1.5x relative volume between 09:30 and 11:00 ET.

label: Gap and go
summary: Gaps 3% or more up or down at the 08:30 ET premarket scan on at least 2x relative volume.

label: N-day breakout
summary: Daily close crosses above the 20-day high on at least 1.5x relative volume.

label: High-of-day break
summary: Closes above the session high on at least 1.5x relative volume between 09:45 and 15:30 ET.

label: VWAP reclaim
summary: Closes back above VWAP between 09:45 and 15:30 ET, checked every 1-minute bar.

label: VWAP loss
summary: Closes below VWAP between 09:45 and 15:30 ET, checked every 1-minute bar.

label: Pullback to 20/50
summary: Daily close within 1% of the 20- or 50-day average while the 20-day sits above the 50-day.

label: RSI reversal
summary: Daily RSI(14) crosses back above 30, leaving oversold territory.

label: Technical bias change
summary: Technical summary bias crosses above +0.1 or below -0.1, checked every 15-minute bar.

label: Red to green
summary: Closes above the prior day's close on at least 1.5x relative volume, checked every 5-minute bar.

label: EMA 9/21 cross
summary: The 9-period EMA crosses the 21-period EMA in either direction, checked every 15-minute bar.

label: Golden / death cross 50/200
summary: The 50-day SMA crosses the 200-day SMA in either direction, checked daily.

label: MACD signal cross
summary: The MACD line (12, 26, 9) crosses its signal line in either direction, checked daily.

label: Volume spike
summary: Relative volume of at least 3x its 10-day average between 09:45 and 15:45 ET, checked every 1-minute bar.

label: Abnormal volume on an up day
summary: Daily relative volume of at least 2x its 10-day average on a close above the prior close.

label: Futures overnight-range break
